status: DRAFT — final list is fixed in P3; names below are the contract Member 2 codes against
row_definition: one row per (GPS observation, candidate arc) pair; candidates = directed arcs within radius_m of the point, at most max_k nearest

id_columns.name: trip_id
id_columns.description: 8-digit trip folder name; GroupKFold groups on this

id_columns.name: obs_idx
id_columns.description: row index of the GPS point in the .track file; (trip_id, obs_idx) identifies an observation / ranking group

id_columns.name: cand_arc
id_columns.description: candidate arc id, local to the trip (never used as a feature)

target_columns.name: label
target_columns.description: 1 if cand_arc is the reference arc aligned to this point by the monotonic DP (labels.py), else 0; at most one 1 per observation

target_columns.name: unreliable
target_columns.description: True if the aligned reference arc is > unreliable_m (50 m) from the point (off-network dwell, route mismatch); drop these rows before training and scoring

features.name: dist_m
features.description: perpendicular distance from the GPS point to the candidate arc

features.name: dist_rank
features.description: rank of dist_m among this observation's candidates (0 = nearest)

features.name: dist_minus_min_m
features.description: dist_m minus the smallest dist_m of the observation

features.name: softmin_share
features.description: exp(-dist_m/sigma) normalised over the observation's candidates (sigma = 10 m draft)

features.name: n_candidates
features.description: number of candidates of this observation (local road density)

features.name: proj_t
features.description: position of the projection along the arc (0 = from-node, 1 = to-node)

features.name: arc_two_way
features.description: 1 if the reverse arc also exists

features.name: from_in_degree
features.description: in-degree of the arc's from-node (junction complexity)

features.name: to_out_degree
features.description: out-degree of the arc's to-node (junction complexity)

features.name: heading_diff_deg
features.description: angle between the smoothed GPS heading (points t-2..t+2) and the arc bearing; separates the two directions of a two-way road

features.name: heading_valid
features.description: 1 if the vehicle moved enough (> 2 m over the window) for the GPS heading to be meaningful

features.name: speed_mps
features.description: smoothed GPS speed over points t-2..t+2

features.name: dt_prev_s
features.description: time since the previous GPS point (large = after a gap)

features.name: window_mean_dist_m
features.description: mean distance of points t-3..t+3 to this arc (temporal consistency)

features.name: window_min_dist_m
features.description: min distance of points t-3..t+3 to this arc

excluded_on_purpose: absolute lon/lat or UTM coordinates (trips are worldwide; would not generalise)
node / arc ids (local to each trip)
